observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Bestcool 10" Air Circulator Fan.
The brand 'BESTCOOL' and model 'S-10' are printed on the box.
The box depicts a standing fan with a circular base and three blades.
The actual item is not shown outside of its packaging.
Text on the box claims 'Noiseless', 'Strong Wind', and 'Cool Design'.

claims.evidence: The box specifies 10 inches (approx 254mm); 280mm is not confirmed by the photo.
The box art shows 3 blades, but the material cannot be confirmed from the photo.
Speed settings are not visible on the packaging shown.
Electrical specifications are not legible on the box in this photo.

risks.risk: The box may be empty, contain a different model, or a damaged unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual fan out of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as a used unit in poor condition

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the fan powered on and oscillating.

risks.risk: Missing assembly components like the base or grill screws.
risks.proof: A photo of the fully assembled fan or all components laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual fan out of the box.
Video of the fan working at all speed settings.
Photo of the manufacturer's label/rating plate on the motor housing.
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown. In the second-hand market, proof of the actual item's existence and physical condition is mandatory for a reliable valuation.
